== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Magisters]] are a prominent [[Imperial]] [[Guild]] characterized by their use of staves and the manipulation of [[Intent]]. These specialized tools, which can be crafted from materials like charred wood, [[Iron|iron]], or crystal-decorated wood, allow members to harness natural forces such as plants, [[Elders]], or the powers of [[Kameira]]. Through these staves and their own [[Intent]], [[Magisters]] are capable of performing significant feats, including levitating objects, controlling elemental forces like wind or ice, and even reducing targets to ashes. Their abilities are often described as being able to manipulate the physical world, such as growing forests or creating dust storms. Members of the [[Guild]] are typically identified by their distinct robes and unique staves. While some serve in specialized roles, such as attendants wearing modern or fashionable attire, others are highly skilled combatants or scholars. [[The Guild]] maintains its own research through journals and internal reports, often studying complex phenomena like the bonding process of [[Soulbound]] individuals. Historically, the organization's foundations were influenced by the philosophies of [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin Maze-walker]], though he is not credited as its founder. [[The Guild]] has been led by prominent figures such as [[Mekendi Maxeus]], a notable instructor at the [[Imperial]] Academy known for wearing a painted black [[The mask|mask]]. Following his death, the [[Guild]] has remained without an appointed leader, potentially awaiting the outcome of ongoing inter-guild conflicts.}}
